**sdd/issue-323-stage-routing/explore**

Full file: openspec/changes/issue-323-stage-routing/explore.md (worktree brain-issue-323, main@1421f35, M5 complete). S1 DONE since 28/08 via #792 (ADR-0019 Am.1 four conditions + ADR-0024 Am.1). S2 = condition 4: the check that replaces assertRoutableStage's flat refusal. Findings: resolveStageEngine never checks the stage is DECLARED (roadmap S2 line unimplemented); every spawn path goes through the refusal; M5's port is the natural enforcement surface (engine declares stage via declareRoles + enabled) — why M5 preceded M8. Conditions 1-2 structural, 3 = S4's parity suite, 4 = the deliverable. THE TENSION: the one live sdd.map entry routes cold-review to engine 'claude' — a PLATFORM (D6), no declareRoles; a declares-the-stage check refuses the maintainer's own working config (#812 workaround). Options A (split check by stage class: lifecycle→engines, custom may name transports), B (platforms become inhabitants — rejected territory, mixes axes), C (cold-review routes to an ENGINE that uses a transport internally — cleanest vocabulary, touches review routing + the #812 dance).
